opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jesse Stewart (employee ID E013) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E013.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: admin
  - comment: Jesse Stewart (E013) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, so admin is permitted. Requested admin; recommend granting admin.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record for E013: contractor with basic security training. Contractors can have read, or write only with advanced training; admin is never permitted. Requested admin, so recommending the maximum allowed: read.
reason: The Security agent's record for E013 classifies Jesse Stewart as a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training, and admin is never permitted. The requested level (admin) is above the maximum allowed for a contractor, so the maximum of read is granted. (Note: HR's note lists the employee as full-time, creating a conflict; however, the security record governs access eligibility and does not permit admin for this employee.)
